approaches_tried.approach: Use a literal digit-6-adjacent-relation-char count delta as the sole before/after safety check
approaches_tried.reason: conflates glyph_six repairs (which do involve literal 6) with absent/control_char repairs in the same document (which do not); replaced with a per-document precomposed-count-increase + whole-file word-count-delta=0 check, a stronger and more precise confirmation

deviations.description: Plan's literal 6-adjacent-relation delta check does not equal repair count for mixed-signature documents (e.g. schewe_2009: 6 repairs, only 4 glyph_six)
deviations.reason: The literal digit-6 count is only a valid proxy for the glyph_six subset, not the full repair count when a document also has control_char/absent occurrences
